issues.problem: The chair is positioned extremely close to the plant it must face, leaving inadequate approach and legroom; the measured accessible share is only 36%.
issues.fix: Move the chair farther east while keeping it oriented toward obj_0022, preserving the hard facing constraint and improving access to both objects.

issues.problem: The wall-mounted whiteboard is placed directly across a window, blocking the glazing and lacking an appropriate solid-wall mounting location.
issues.fix: Relocate the whiteboard to an unobstructed solid section of wall, oriented toward the conference area.

issues.problem: The sideboard and tall storage shelf intrude into window areas, obstructing daylight and window use; the tall shelf is particularly unsuitable beside the glazing.
issues.fix: Move both storage pieces to solid wall sections without windows, keeping their fronts accessible from the room.

fixes.reason: reviewer did not prefer the change in both orders

votes.reason: Layout 1 places the whiteboard beside the conference area and near the related wall clock, opposite the wall monitor, making it practical and visually coherent for meetings. Layout 2 isolates it on the far north wall.
